Subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep-dive for secure hosting options

Hi Alex / Katie —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand MedSys’s high-level constraints and goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a deep-dive with the tech/infrastructure folks: 

Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary goals: bring LLM-powered summarization into patient intake workflows while keeping PHI inside customer-managed networking.
- Likely deployment modes under consideration: Private VPC (Redwood Private) or on-prem appliance for air-gapped sites.
- Key non-functional requirements: FIPS/KMS integration, audit logs retention (7 years), sustained 150 reqs/min peak, sub-200ms token latency target for 512-token generation.

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical deep-dive to align on network topology, security controls (KMS/HSM), firewall rules, and rollout plan. Can Marissa (SE) and I join to walk through: 1) recommended architecture options, 2) expected firewall/K8s requirements, 3) high-level performance sizing, and 4) a draft rollout roadmap.

Times we have open (PT):
- Wed 27 Jan, 10:00–11:00
- Thu 28 Jan, 13:00–14:00
- Fri 29 Jan, 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, please propose 2 alternatives. Also helpful if you can:
- Confirm which internal folks will attend (network/security lead + infra/ops).
- Share a network diagram or CIDR ranges if available (we can keep everything redacted).
- Tell us whether you prefer Private VPC or on-prem for the initial pilot — we’ll tailor the agenda.

Attaching: redwood-privdeploy-checklist.pdf (short checklist we use to scope work).

Appreciate a quick confirmation and we’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
